capabilities: Render cmap blocks as interactive 3D concept graphs
Rotate, pan, zoom and focus graph nodes
Extract relation triples from cmap blocks across the vault
Generate concept pages and a concept index
Update generated pages incrementally on rebuild
disambiguation: Not a mind-map or diagram editor; it renders concept–relation triples from cmap blocks and from generated concept pages.
extras: Bilingual Chinese/English README. Rendering is read-only; building only writes to the configured concept folder, marks generated pages with generated_by: three-d-concept-map, never overwrites unmarked user files, and moves removed concepts to an old-concepts folder instead of deleting them. No network access or telemetry.
problem: Relations between concepts written in notes have no visual, clickable form, and there is no way to turn them into browsable concept pages.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT → BRAT: Add a beta plugin → jaegerzhang001-max/3d-concept-map

summary: Renders cmap code blocks as rotatable 3D concept graphs and can scan a vault to generate concept pages and an index.
